metadata.title: SolidWorks CAD Weldment Operations — Multi-body weldment authoring layer
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the SolidWorks CAD weldment authoring layer. Weldments are multi-body parts where each body represents a structural member (tube / channel / angle / I-beam / custom profile) joined at corners with controllable trim/extend treatments. Catalog covers WELDMENT (the foundational multi-body marker), STRUCTURAL_MEMBER (sketch-driven member with profile library + 3 corner treatments + per-segment rotation/mirror), 3 trim/extend ops (TRIM_EXTEND / EXTEND_BY_PLANE / END_TRIM_TO_BODY), 3 reinforcement ops (END_CAP / GUSSET / FILLET_WELD_BEAD), 2 weld authoring ops (WELD_BEAD / SPOT_WELD), 2 cut/multi-body management ops (CUT_LIST_GENERATE / WELDMENT_BODY_RENAME), and 3 custom profile / cut-list refinement ops (CUSTOM_PROFILE_DEFINE / WELDMENT_BODY_PROPERTY / CUT_LIST_SUMMARY). 15 operations / 122 parameters total. Bindings target IFeatureManager.InsertWeldment / InsertWeldmentMember / InsertTrimExtend / InsertEndCap / InsertWeldmentGusset / InsertWeldBead / InsertSpotWeld / GenerateCutList — the canonical SolidWorks 2024 weldment authoring API.
metadata.source: SolidWorks 2024 API Help — Weldments; SolidWorks API Reference — IFeatureManager (weldment methods); SolidWorks 2024 Weldments toolbar / Insert > Weldments menu; AISC Steel Construction Manual (structural shapes); AWS A2.4 (weld symbols); ISO 657 (steel sections)

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across SolidWorks weldment operations

WELDMENT.description: Weldment marker feature — promotes a part to a weldment (multi-body part with cut list automation). Adds the Cut-List-Item folder to the FeatureManager. First weldment feature in a part is typically auto-inserted by STRUCTURAL_MEMBER, but can be explicitly inserted to mark a multi-body part as a weldment without yet adding members.

parameters.name: Auto-Generate Cut List
parameters.description: Auto-create Cut-List-Item folder

parameters.name: Update Custom Properties
parameters.description: Refresh body custom properties on rebuild

parameters.name: Use Material Definition
parameters.description: Optional default material name applied to all bodies

STRUCTURAL_MEMBER.description: Add a structural member by sweeping a profile from a library along sketch segments. Profile Library Path resolves to a SolidWorks profile catalog (e.g. ANSI inch / ANSI metric / ISO / DIN / JIS / Australian / Indian standards). Corner Treatment controls how adjacent members meet (trimmed_butt / coped / lapped). Per-segment Rotation Angle rotates the profile about the path; Mirror Profile flips the cross-section.

parameters.name: Path Segments
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of sketch segments (lines / arcs)

parameters.name: Allow Cosmetic Welds
parameters.description: Auto-add cosmetic weld beads at member intersections

parameters.name: Size Designation
parameters.description: Catalog size string (e.g. '2x2x0.125', 'W8x21', 'C6x8.2')

parameters.name: Custom Profile Path
parameters.description: Required when Profile Type = custom (path to .sldlfp profile file)

parameters.name: Locate Profile
parameters.description: Vertex on profile sketch used as the path-attachment point

parameters.name: Gap Between Members
parameters.description: Per-corner gap distance for trimmed_butt

parameters.name: Cope Allowance
parameters.description: Material allowance left at coped joint

TRIM_EXTEND.description: Trim or extend a weldment body to a planar / face / body boundary. Action selects trim (remove material past boundary) vs extend (add material to reach boundary). Allow Extension is required when boundary is on the far side of the body's existing extent.

parameters.name: Bodies To Trim
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of weldment body names

parameters.name: Trim Boundary Selection
parameters.description: Face / plane (face_plane) or body list (bodies)

parameters.name: Weld Gap
parameters.description: Optional gap to leave for weld fillet

EXTEND_BY_PLANE.description: Extend a weldment body to a reference plane without trimming the existing material. Used to add stub extensions to existing members for downstream cut/trim operations.

parameters.name: Extend Past Plane
parameters.description: Optional overshoot distance past plane

END_TRIM_TO_BODY.description: Trim a weldment body's end against another body (e.g. a structural member ending at a perpendicular member). Coping Type selects how the trim shape conforms (face_to_face / weld_gap / nominal_butt).
END_TRIM_TO_BODY.solidworks_command: Insert > Weldments > End Trim to Body

END_CAP.description: Add a flat end cap to a hollow structural member (typically a tube or pipe). Thickness Direction selects inward (cap extends into tube) / outward (cap extends out from tube end) / centered (cap straddles the end face).

parameters.name: End Faces
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tube end faces

parameters.name: Offset From End
parameters.description: Recess cap from end face (Thickness Direction = inward only)

parameters.name: Use Tube Outer Wall Thickness
parameters.description: Default cap thickness to host tube wall

parameters.name: Chamfer Distance
parameters.description: Required when Add Chamfer = true

GUSSET.description: Triangular or polygonal weldment gusset between two structural members. Profile Type selects triangular (3-vertex) vs polygonal (4+ vertices). Distance 1 / Distance 2 control the gusset leg lengths along each member.

parameters.name: Reference Face A
parameters.description: Face on first member

parameters.name: Reference Face B
parameters.description: Face on second (perpendicular / angled) member

parameters.name: Center Offset
parameters.description: Offset from corner intersection

FILLET_WELD_BEAD.description: Cosmetic fillet weld bead — represents a fillet weld in CAD without adding actual material to the model. Bead Size sets the fillet leg length per AWS A2.4. Tack Weld Length / Pitch govern intermittent welds.

parameters.name: Face Set 1
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of faces on first body

parameters.name: Face Set 2
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of faces on second body

parameters.name: Tack Length
parameters.description: Required for intermittent / staggered_intermittent

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.description: Center-to-center spacing for intermittent welds

WELD_BEAD.description: Material-bearing weld bead (groove / fillet / plug / stud / spot per AWS A2.4) that adds visible material to the model and contributes to mass/COG. Distinct from FILLET_WELD_BEAD which is cosmetic-only.

parameters.name: Joint Edges
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of edges defining the joint

parameters.name: Material
parameters.description: Filler material spec (e.g. 'E70S-6', 'ER70S-2')

parameters.name: Other Side Size
parameters.description: 0 = no other-side weld

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: 0 = continuous along joint edges

parameters.name: Mass Contribution
parameters.description: Include weld mass in part mass properties

parameters.name: Process Reference
parameters.description: Optional AWS process code (e.g. 'GMAW', 'SMAW', 'GTAW', 'FCAW')

SPOT_WELD.description: Spot weld point feature — discrete resistance / projection welds typical in sheet metal weldments. Diameter sets the weld nugget diameter. Pattern Type drives spacing (single / linear / rectangular / circular grid).

parameters.name: Weld Locations
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of point selections or sketch points

parameters.name: Pattern Pitch
parameters.description: Spacing between welds in pattern

parameters.name: Process Reference
parameters.description: Optional AWS process code (e.g. 'RSW', 'PRW')

CUT_LIST_GENERATE.description: Generate or update the Cut-List-Item folder — auto-groups identical bodies (same profile, same length within tolerance) and assigns quantity counts. Length Tolerance controls grouping — bodies within tolerance are treated as identical.
CUT_LIST_GENERATE.solidworks_command: Update Cut List (right-click Cut List folder)

parameters.name: Length Tolerance
parameters.description: Length difference at which 2 bodies are still considered the same item

parameters.name: Group By Material
parameters.description: Separate same-profile bodies of different materials

parameters.name: Group By Custom Property
parameters.description: Optional custom property name to add to grouping key

WELDMENT_BODY_RENAME.description: Rename or reorder weldment bodies in the FeatureManager. Used to enforce shop-floor naming conventions (e.g. tag bodies by drawing item number) and stabilize cut-list ordering across rebuilds.

parameters.name: Move To Folder
parameters.description: Optional Cut-List-Item folder name

parameters.name: Reorder Position
parameters.description: Position in folder (-1 = last)

parameters.name: Sync Custom Properties
parameters.description: Update body's custom property name reference

WELDMENT_BODY_PROPERTY.description: Set custom properties on a weldment body (used for cut list column population). Standard properties include Description / Material / Quantity / Length / Item Number — but any custom property can be applied per body.

CUT_LIST_SUMMARY.description: Generate a summary report of the cut list (bodies / quantities / lengths / total weights / total cost). Output Format selects table layout for downstream BOM / drawing / inspection consumption.

parameters.name: Output Path
parameters.description: Required for csv / xml output

parameters.name: Include Cost
parameters.description: Compute cost from material density x volume x material-cost custom property

parameters.name: Cost Per Unit Mass Property
parameters.description: Body custom property name for cost per kg

parameters.name: Total Cost Currency
parameters.description: Currency code (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP')

CUSTOM_PROFILE_DEFINE.description: Define a custom weldment profile (.sldlfp library part). Used when shop-floor uses non-standard structural shapes not in the built-in catalog. Profile sketch must be a single closed contour for tube/solid sections, or include inner contours for hollow sections.

parameters.name: Profile Sketch
parameters.description: Single closed sketch (or sketch with inner contours for hollow sections)

parameters.name: Locate Point
parameters.description: Vertex defining path-attachment origin

parameters.name: Output Path
parameters.description: Path to save .sldlfp library profile file

parameters.name: Standard Library
parameters.description: Standard name for catalog grouping (e.g. 'shop_custom', 'project_xyz')

parameters.name: Size Designation
parameters.description: Size string under the profile category (e.g. '50x50x3')

parameters.name: Mass Per Unit Length Override
parameters.description: Optional override of computed mass per unit length
